note:
Osvo - Babulas recipe — Answer from Yidi (Nov 15, 2026): Potatoes should be optional, like 2 golden potatoes.
Eggs also optional, say 2.
Also, in the crock pot, it should get cooled on low for like 20 hours (then keep warm until lunch)
text:
1 cup rice (any, not sticky rice)
2 carrot (shredded)

Dry tomato, or 1 small tomato 
2-3 dried plumbs (prunes), cube
Olcha
1 onion, chopped
1 Apple
3/4 Tbsp olcha
Lamb shank (if we have)
Beef, few pieces
(Optional) Orange squash

First put little oil in pot (2tbsp)
Put in sliced carrots, until gets brownish 
Then put in onion, tomato, plums, is meat (with shank)l
Then wash rice 3 times
Put into pot
Add salt (1.5tsp), spices (red pepper flakes, tumeric, paprika)
3 cups water cover completely (knuckle length)
Can put in a potato or eggs
Then transfer to crock pot
